mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_uuid) FROM tech_english_ai_recognition_record WHERE createby = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT session_uuid, MAX(source_name) AS source_name, MAX(scenario) AS scenario, MAX(chunk_count) AS chunk_count, COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(status = 'PROCESSING') AS processing_count, SUM(status = 'RECOGNIZED') AS recognized_count, SUM(status = 'FAILED') AS failed_count, SUM(status = 'IMPORTED') AS imported_count, SUM(image_count) AS image_count, SUM(item_count) AS item_count, MIN(createtime) AS createtime, MAX(updatetime) AS updatetime FROM tech_english_ai_recognition_record WHERE createby = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY session_uuid ORDER BY MIN(createtime) DESC, MAX(id) DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
